selection_purpose: Post-hoc curated illustration only, not an evaluation sample.
passage_rule: Retain the original three pairs. Add the lowest mean percentile-rank pairs, with at most three passages per article. Compute input ranks within NR/IS from full 50-draw mean NLD and duration-normalized ScaSim, then average equally across version x task cells. Require all eight version/task/question inputs with at least two human readers.
draw_rule: For every displayed condition, rank each of 50 archived draws by its mean NLD and duration-normalized ScaSim against all matching human paths. Average the two within-condition percentile ranks and retain the lowest five (archive index breaks ties). Preserve every matched human record in its original order. No new sampling or fitting.
